"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats believe the health care system should put people before profits.",

"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Those over 55 should be able to opt in to Medicare.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will empower the states to use innovation waivers under the Affordable Care Act to develop unique locally tailored approaches to health coverage.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will empower the states to remove barriers to states which seek to experiment with plans to ensure universal health care to every person in their state.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Donald Trump wants to repeal the Affordable Care Act, leaving tens of millions of Americans without coverage.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
